translation.name: Moppiyon Dinoggan, Moka-atag ki Disas Krays

book.name: MATEO
book.title: Dos Moppiyon Dinoggan no id Sulat ni MATEO

content: Dos Ko-ossan to Nonaw to mgo Pariseo taddot Suhu to Monama
Na, duwon mgo Pariseo woy mgo tohodnonaw to Suhu ni Moises no id pomon diyot Jerusalem. Id porani ran ki Disas woy mid intud, kahi ran to,

“Mambot id supak moho to mgo tinodduwan du iddos botasanon to kovuyyahan ta amoy'd molinis diyot kod-ontong to Monama? Oyyos id ka-an dan no waa id ounab to bollad amoy'd ikuu to botasanon atag to kodlinis.”
Mid tavak si Disas to, “Na sikiyu, mambot id supak dow kos mgo suhu to Monama ukit to kod-ikuu row to koniyun botasanon?
Su id suhu to Monama no, ‘Rispitu kow to amoy woy inoy row,’
woy ‘Iddos ahad ondoy nod oseng to morat diyot amoy o inoy rin, ko-ilangan en nod imotayan.’

Piru sikiyu, ossa moho kos nonaw row. Su iddos minuvu no duwon nanoy id pokotavang diyot amoy woy inoy rin, od bolivad baling sikandin woy'd oseng to, ‘Duwon nanoy tavang ku koniyu, piru id ossa kud ini atag to Monama.’
De-en id podwora row iddos suhu to Monama ukit to kod-ikuu row taddot koniyun botasanon.
Sikiyu nod po-uvag-uvag no motallong! Bonnaa en iddos id poposaddoo to Monama ukit ki Isaias moka-atag koniyu no mid ungketen to,

content.text: ‘Inin mgo minuvu, taman da to dila kos kodposivantug dan koddi,
piru moriyu kos pusung dan koddi.
Waa koru-anon to kodsimba ran koddi,
su iddos id nonaw ran, id bobbovallan da to mgo minuvu.’ ”

content: Dos od Pokolibmit to Minuvu riyot Kod-ontong to Monama
Na, id poporani ni Disas iddos mo-uraan minuvu woy id ikohiyan din to, “Pominog kow woy ooyyari row ini tod labbotlabbot.
Konnod pokolibmit iddos koka-an no id sungit to minuvu riyot bivig din. Iyon od pokolibmit kandin, idda en so morat no osengan nod leggua to bivig din.”
Na, id porani ki Disas iddos mgo tinodduwan din woy mid ikahi to, “Nokosaddoo ka vo no nomorat kos mgo Pariseo taddot id oseng du?”
Mid tavak si Disas to, “Iddos ipat pinomuwa no waa id pomuwa taddot Amoy ku no riyot datas to langit, od boruton.
Podtohona row sikandan, su noko-iling dan to mgo butud nod inahak to iling dan no butud. Otik butud kos od inahak to iling din no butud, od pokodtapik en sikandan nod ko-uug diyot moraom no bobbo.”
Na mid ikahi si Pedro to, “Paabbotlabbot du konami iddos kohulugan taddot ponunggelengan.”
Kahin Disas to, “Nosoobbuwan a koniyu, su iling kow vos mandad to dumon minuvu no waa poron nokaabbot.
Waa kow vos nokosaddoo no iddos ahad ondan no koka-an nod usok diyot bivig to minuvu, od undiyon to gottok woy od leggua?
Piru iddos od leggua to bivig, id pomon idda riyot ginawa, woy idda en kos od pokolibmit to minuvu.

Oyyos id pomon diyot ginawa iddos morat no poomdom, no idda en kos od piyod kandin nod puung to kod-imatoy, kodloivug woy dumon molibmit no pinuungan, kodponakow, kodposivonnaa to uhus woy koddoddora-at to duma.
Na ini en langun kos od pokolibmit to minuvu. Piru iddos kodka-an no waa mid ikuu to botasanon moka-atag to kod-ounab to bollad, konna idda kos od pokolibmit to minuvu.”
Dos Kopomakoy to Ba-ay no Konna Judio
Na, id tanan si Disas dutun woy mid undiyon to lugaa no sakup to mgo bonuwa to Tiro woy Sidon.

Na, duwon sokkad no ba-ay no id oubpa rutun. Iddon ba-ay, konna Judio, su toho Canaan sikandin. Id porani sikandin ki Disas woy id po-eru-eru, kahi rin to, “Longaggon, lubbad ni David, ko-eruwan ka koddi! Su iddos anak ku no ba-ay, oray'n noosayan pomon to busow no id lasud kandin.”
Piru waa mid tavak si Disas, ahad songo-kahi. De-en id porani kandin iddos mgo tinodduwan din woy mid ikahi to, “Po-owa-aw kos ba-ay, su id tinundug sikandin keta no oray'd poko-ulingoo.”
Kahin Disas taddot ba-ay to, “Id popiyod a to Monama atag da to koubbaran ni Israel no noko-iling to nongotarin no karnero.”
Piru id porani ra en sikandin ki Disas woy mid lingko-od diyot isowwan din. Kahi rin to, “Longaggon, tovangi a!”
Id tavak si Disas kandin ukit to ponunggelengan, kahi rin to, “Konna en ollog nod ongayon iddos koka-an to mgo anak woy id sunggud diyot mgo tuyyang.”
Kahi taddot ba-ay to, “Oyya, Longaggon, piru ahad pa iddos mgo tuyyang, od pokoka-an man to mgo mumu nod pongo-uug diyot silob
to lomisa taddot amu ran.”
Mid tavak si Disas to, “Tiya, dakkoo kos kopomakoy ru! Od kotuman en kos od buyuwon du.” Na idda ron en, no-uliyan iddos anak din.
Mo-uraa kos No-uliyan ukit to Kotuusan ni Disas
Na, id awa si Disas dutun woy id pongulibpit diyon to Lanow't Galilea. Id tikoddog sikandin diyot lovuntud woy mid unsad dutun.

Mo-uraa kos minuvu nid undiyon to kandin. Id duma ran iddos mgo pungku, mgo butud, mgo minuvu no id patoy kos pa-a, mgo ommow woy duma pa. Id piyod dan idda riyot isowwan ni Disas woy langun dan, no-uliyan ukit to kotuusan din.

Na, nosoobbuwan iddos mgo minuvu no nokokita tadda, oyyos od poko-ooseng don iddos mgo ommow, no-uliyan iddos mgo pungku, noko-ipanow ron iddos mgo minuvu nid patoy kos pa-a woy nokokita ron iddos mgo butud. De-en id doong dan kos Monama nod simba-anon to mgo toho Israel.
Dos Kodpoka-an ni Disas to Oppat no Maan (4,000) no Minuvu

Na, id poporani ni Disas iddos mgo tinodduwan din woy id ikohiyan din to, “No-eruwan a ka-ay't mo-uraan minuvu, oyyos notolluwan don nid duma ran koddi no worad tasak dan. Dii a od kopiyan nod po-uliyon ku sikandan no diid pokoka-an, su saddook od moomet dan to gutas diyot daan.”
Kahi taddot mgo tinodduwan din to, “Oyya en, piru ingkon ki man od poko-angoy to koka-an no ollog ka-ay't oray'n mo-uraan minuvu no ini ki man to noka-awoy-awoy'n lugaa?”
Mid intud si Disas kandan, kahi rin to, “Pilon molison kos paan duwot koniyu?” Mid tavak sikandan to, “Pittu woy pilopilon moollimot no ngaap.”
Na, id po-unsad ni Disas iddos mo-uraan minuvu.

Woy id angoy rin iddos pittun paan woy dos mgo ngaap woy id posolamat sikandin diyot Monama. Nopongnga, id pontoppiktoppik din idda woy id boggoy riyot mgo tinodduwan din amoy id sondad diyot mgo minuvu.
Na, nokoka-an dan langun woy nongovuung. Woy nokolimud pe-en iddos mgo tinodduwan din to nongosama no nokoponnu to pittun doorakkoon bukag.
Iddos ko-uralloy to minuvu nid ka-an, mgo oppat no maan (4,000) no mama, waa pa apii to kod-iyap iddos mgo ba-ay woy mgo anak.
Nopongnga idda, id popo-uli ni Disas iddos mgo minuvu, woy mid sakoy sikandin to bollangay po-undiyot Magadan.

footnotes.text: Od kovasa ini riyot Exodo 20:12; Deuteronomio 5:16.
